title: Ar-Raqib: The Divine Name Isa Hands Back on the Day of Judgement
excerpt: Ar-Raqib appears five times. In one, Isa says he watched over his people while he was among them — and that when he was taken, the watching became God’s.
seo_title: Ar-Raqib: Meaning of the Divine Name in the Quran
seo_description: Ar-Raqib, the Watchful, appears five times in the Quran. Isa uses it at 5:117 to mark where his own responsibility ended. What the name means.
